tagline: Full-featured download manager for NAS and home servers
description:
Motrix is an open-source download manager with a clean interface and dark mode. This ZimaOS package runs it as a headless server: a self-contained web UI for HTTP, BitTorrent, and magnet downloads, with SQLite-backed sessions, tracker management, upload/download speed limits, plugin sandboxing, and secure device-code pairing for the official `@motrix/cli` and agent clients.

Because upstream has not published official server images yet, this package uses a snapshot image built from upstream commit `7991744` (`ghcr.io/runui/motrix-server:7991744`). App state (database, settings, aria2 sessions, torrent metadata, plugins, operator token) persists in `/data`, and downloaded files are written to `/downloads`.

**Notes:**
- Web UI: `http://<zimaos-ip>:18090`
- Port `16801` (MDXP) is published for pairing remote CLI/agent clients; set `MOTRIX_PUBLIC_URL` to the reachable Web URL so remote clients receive a usable approval URL.
- Direct HTTP is intended for trusted LANs; use a TLS reverse proxy for internet exposure.

tips.before_install:
## Setup Notes

- On first start Motrix generates an operator token at `/data/operator-token`; the web UI pairing flow approves CLI/agent device codes, and there is no default web login password.
- Set `MOTRIX_PUBLIC_URL` (for example `http://<zimaos-ip>:18090`) when pairing the official Motrix CLI or agent clients from other machines; do not use `localhost` in this value.
- Plain HTTP is appropriate on a trusted LAN only. For remote access, put a TLS reverse proxy in front of ports `18090` and `16801` and protect the origin ports with firewall rules.
- This image is a development snapshot built from upstream commit `7991744`; upstream has not published an official server image yet. Track upstream releases and re-package when the first official image lands.
- The icon is the official upstream app icon; the thumbnail and screenshot are placeholders made from the same icon because upstream does not ship web UI screenshots.
